2016-10: Order Total

Suppose you have a numeric vector that is the list of prices for a set of retail products.

You also have a numeric vector that is the number ordered of each product.

Write a function that takes as its right argument a vector of prices and as its left argument a numeric vector that indicates the number ordered and returns the total cost for the order.

Define a function named Total; the tests below will call it.
